name: Menna
title: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
summary: Menna is a person mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus in the Gospel of Luke, chapter 3. He is listed as the son of Mattatha and the father of Melea. Very little is known about him beyond his place in the lineage from David to Jesus.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus
keyEvents.description: Menna is mentioned in Luke's genealogy of Jesus Christ as part of the Davidic line through Nathan, son of David.

keyEvents.title: Link in the line from David to Jesus
keyEvents.description: Menna serves as an important link in the lineage from King David through his son Nathan and down to Joseph, the earthly father of Jesus.

keyEvents.title: Part of God's story of salvation
keyEvents.description: Through his place in the genealogy, Menna is part of the great story of God's faithful plan to bring the Messiah into the world through David's line.

keyEvents.title: Connection to the Promise of the Messiah
keyEvents.description: Menna's placement in the genealogy confirms the fulfillment of God's promise that the Messiah would come from David's lineage, as prophesied in the Old Testament.
